faqs.a:
The city council finds, determines, and declares that at times automobiles parked
               on streets located near certain public schools and parks may cause traffic congestion
               on such streets such that they threaten the health, convenience, safety, and welfare
               of the public. The city council deems it necessary to regulate parking on such streets
               in order to reduce traffic hazards and congestion, reduce the overburdening of existing
               streets and roads, encourage the use of public transportation to reduce air pollution
               and the other environmental effects of the use of private motor vehicles and enable
               residents of certain areas to obtain adequate parking near their residences.
(Code 1981, § 17-125; Ord. No. 2804, § 1, 4-15-1991; Ord. No. 2996, § 1, 8-16-1993;
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
